description: Under the night sky, the Tablas de Daimiel wetlands spread out in a dark, shimmering expanse. Standing at the water's edge, you take in the lagoon surface with its reed beds and distant treeline just visible in the dim light. The frame holds the wetland's calm after dark — a rare quiet for one of Spain's most precious water landscapes.
